verses.text: <pb/><t>Ina kwance a gadona dukan dare,</t> <t>Ina mafarki da ƙaunataccena,</t> <t>Na neme shi, amma ban same shi ba.</t> <t>Na kira shi, amma ba amsa.</t>
<t>Bari in tashi yanzu in shiga birni,</t> <t>In bi titi-titi, in bi dandali-dandali,</t> <t>In nemi wanda raina yake ƙauna.</t> <t>Na neme shi, amma ban same shi ba.</t>
<t>Da matsaran da suke kai da kawowa cikin birni suka gan ni,</t> <t>Sai na tambaye su ko sun ga ƙaunataccena.</t>
<t>Rabuwata da matsaran ke nan,</t> <t>Sai na yi kaciɓis da ƙaunataccena.</t> <t>Na riƙe shi, ban sake shi ba,</t> <t>Na kai shi gidanmu, har ɗakin mahaifiyata. <pb/></t>
<t>Ku 'yan matan Urushalima,</t> <t>Ku rantse da bareyi da batsiyoyi,</t> <t>Ba za ka shiga tsakaninmu ba,</t> <t>Ku bar ta kurum.</t>
<t>Wane ne wannan da yake fitowa daga cikin jeji,</t> <t>Kamar tunnuƙewar hayaƙi cike da kayan ƙanshi iri iri na fatake?</t>
<t>Ai, duba suna ɗauke da karaga wadda aka shirya domin Sulemanu,</t> <t>Dakarai sittin na kewaye da karagar,</t> <t>Zaɓaɓɓun sojoji daga cikin Isra'ila.</t>
<t>Dukansu gwanayen yaƙi da takobi ne, gogaggu ne na aikin soja,</t> <t>Kowannensu yana da takobi,</t> <t>Suna tsaro don kada a hume su da dare.</t>
<t>Ana ɗauke da sarki Sulemanu a karagar da aka shirya da itace mafi kyau.</t>

<t>An dalaye ginshiƙanta da azurfa,</t> <t>An rufe ta da zane da aka yi wa ado da zinariya.</t> <t>An lulluɓe wurin zama da zanen shunayya.</t> <t>Matan Urushalima sun yi mata irin yayin da ake yi na ƙauna.</t>
<t>Matan Sihiyona, ku fito ku ga sarki Sulemanu</t> <t>Ya sa kambin sarauta,</t> <t>Wanda uwarsa ta sa masa, a ranar aurensa,</t> <t>A ranarsa ta murna da farin ciki.</t>
